description: Use to read what a receipt says (who did what for whom, when, with what outcome): fetches a single execution receipt by id together with its verification records. To test whether the receipt holds up, use inam_verify_receipt. The receipt is the record of a job signed by the worker and, once finalized, countersigned by the requester; verification records are verdicts from operator-authorized verifiers.
name: inam_get_receipt
